Figure 2:Training withFork.Given a prompt, a policy model samples a response, which is then divided into units.
An LLM grader matches rubrics to units to assign each unit a necessity credit and determines a credit threshold for unit necessity.
In parallel, the grader assesses the factual correctness of all units.
Precision is defined as the fraction of necessary and factually correct units, and recall follows the standard definition of weighted rubric coverage.
We update the policy model using their weighted harmonic mean as a reward.
